title: Business Systems Services Manager
jobDescription:
The Manager, HRIS is responsible for the administration, support, and continuous improvement of the organization's Workday platform. This role partners with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to ensure Workday effectively supports business processes, delivers accurate data, and provides a positive user experience. The role oversees system configuration, enhancements, reporting, testing, release activities, and issue resolution while maintaining strong governance and data integrity.

 

Key Responsibilities

Workday Administration & Support

  • Manage the day-to-day administration and support of the Workday platform.

  • Configure and maintain Workday business processes, organizations, security, and related functionality.

  • Troubleshoot system issues and partner with stakeholders and Workday Support to resolve them.

  • Ensure system configurations align with business requirements and established governance standards.

Enhancements & Continuous Improvement

  • Gather and analyze business requirements and recommend scalable Workday solutions.

  • Lead the design, testing, and deployment of system enhancements and process improvements.

  • Evaluate new Workday functionality and coordinate adoption of features that provide business value.

  • Maintain documentation for configurations, processes, and system changes.

Workday Release Readiness & Functional Validation

  • Stay informed on upcoming Workday releases and assess potential impacts to HR processes, configurations, and user experience.

  • Review new functionality and enhancements to identify opportunities and risks for the business.

  • Partner with the Release Management team to support release planning, impact assessments, and testing activities.

  • Coordinate and facilitate business testing, ensuring key stakeholders validate changes and confirm readiness.

  • Communicate relevant release updates, impacts, and recommendations to HR stakeholders.

  • Support the evaluation and adoption of new Workday features aligned with business priorities.

Data Integrity & Reporting Support

  • Ensure data integrity and consistency within Workday through effective system configuration and governance.

  • Support business stakeholders with basic operational reporting and scheduled report monitoring.

  • Partner with reporting teams to define requirements, validate outputs, and troubleshoot data-related issues.

  • Participate in data audits and quality reviews to ensure reliable HR data.

Integrations & Vendor Coordination

  • Partner with integration and IT teams to support inbound and outbound Workday integrations.

  • Assist with troubleshooting integration issues and validating data flows.

  • Manage Workday support cases and coordinate with Workday resources as required.

Stakeholder Leadership & Influence

  • Lead cross-functional discussions involving HR, Payroll, IT, and business stakeholders to drive alignment and decision-making.

  • Build strong partnerships across functions to understand business needs and recommend appropriate Workday solutions.

  • Influence outcomes by combining HR process knowledge, Workday expertise, and data-driven insights.

  • Drive initiatives and enhancements from requirements gathering through implementation, ensuring stakeholder engagement throughout the process.

  • Act as a functional subject matter expert for Workday and provide guidance to stakeholders on system capabilities and best practices.

  • Translate business requirements into Workday solutions and process improvements.

  • Provide guidance on Workday capabilities, best practices, and system functionality.

  • Deliver end-user support and training as needed.

This is a highly strategic leadership role responsible for developing and scaling a team of Solutions Engineers who partner with customers to modernize service operations, improve employee experiences, and accelerate digital transformation initiatives. You will play a critical role in driving revenue growth, increasing win rates, expanding industry expertise, and helping customers realize the value of AI-powered service management.

We're looking for a leader who thrives at the intersection of technology, business strategy, industry expertise, and people development. Someone who can coach teams to excellence, influence executive stakeholders, and build go-to-market motions that help Freshworks win in key growth markets.

As a leader in our Solution Engineering org, you will be responsible for overseeing one of our high performing,  Solution Engineering team.   • You are a keen strategist who can build competitive playbooks and work closely with product marketing to evangelize these playbooks within our global SE org.

  • Finally, you are an experienced manager who values excellence over outcomes and knows how to nurture and build. You trust by default and use transparency to foster trust

title: Lead - Business Analyst (Sales Operations)
jobDescription:
Role Overview

In today’s fast-evolving business landscape, operational excellence is the ultimate competitive advantage. As our Manager - Sales Operations, you won’t just manage standard CRM workflows—you will be the strategic engine driving Go-To-Market (GTM) velocity and efficiency. This dynamic role requires a highly adaptable, execution-focused professional who views the sales ecosystem as a constantly evolving product. Sitting at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, you will translate data-driven insights into frictionless revenue processes. If you possess the learning agility to master new tech stacks instantly, the cross-functional empathy to align diverse teams, and the analytical rigor to clear roadblocks from the sales cycle, this role offers the perfect platform to scale our revenue operations.

The Impact You Can Create

  • Accelerate GTM Velocity: Streamline and automate the end-to-end sales lifecycle, reducing administrative friction and maximizing the time reps spend selling.

  • Unify the Data Ecosystem: Build a single source of truth across the revenue organization, enabling leadership to make agile, data-driven decisions during market pivots.

  • Foster Cross-Functional Synergy: Act as a consultative partner across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Product to eliminate operational silos and build seamless customer journeys.

  • Scale the Tech Stack: Modernize and optimize our revenue tool ecosystem, ensuring high user adoption and rapid integration of next-generation tools.

Roles & Responsibilities (R&R)

1. Process Optimization & Lifecycle Strategy

  • Design, implement, and continuously refine sales workflows (from lead routing to contract execution) to optimize sales productivity.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks in the sales funnel and deploy creative, automated solutions to resolve them.

  • Maintain a continuous feedback loop with frontline reps to ensure processes support, rather than hinder, their daily workflows.

2. Cross-Functional Pipeline & Forecasting

  • Partner closely with Sales Leadership and Finance to manage forecasting models, pipeline hygiene, and territory allocations.

  • Validate pipeline health data, conversion metrics, and historical trends against the Annual Operating Plan (AOP).

  • Drive structured, data-backed forecasting rhythms that give the executive team predictable visibility into revenue.

3. Tech Stack Governance & Innovation

  • Oversee the administration and optimization of our CRM platform and integrated sales tools (e.g., sequencing, conversation intelligence, and enrichment platforms).

  • Evaluate, test, and deploy emerging operational technologies, prioritizing architectural flexibility and vendor-agnostic scalability.

  • Enforce rigorous data hygiene and compliance frameworks across all integrated systems.

4. Advanced Analytics & Business Intelligence

  • Build and maintain intuitive, executive-level dashboards that track key GTM performance indicators (KPIs) like win rates, sales velocity, and rep productivity.

  • Deliver actionable operational insights during Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to shape strategic resource allocation.

5. Change Management & Enablement Collaboration

  • Lead the rollout of new operational processes and system updates, ensuring high adoption through clear documentation and empathetic training.

  • Partner with Sales Enablement to translate system data into tailored coaching opportunities for the revenue team.

Role Overview

As a Staff Product Manager on the IT Operations Management (ITOM) product team, you will serve as a highly experienced individual contributor and a recognized domain expert who thrives at the intersection of complex technology and human collaboration. This role is built for a dynamic product leader who pairs deep technical foundations with the learning agility required to navigate rapidly shifting market landscapes. Sitting as the strategic and operational linchpin across design, engineering, marketing, and sales, you will act as a true cross-functional champion. You will not only define a bold product vision but will continuously adapt it based on customer empathy, emerging technologies, and real-time feedback loops. If you possess a relentless curiosity to master new domains, a collaborative spirit that bridges technical and business divides, and a passion for turning complex operational processes into elegant global solutions, this role offers an expansive platform for your craft.

The Impact You Can Create

  • Pioneer Bold Innovation: Drive market-defining product ideas from concept to reality, leveraging thought leadership to keep our ITOM platform at the cutting edge of the industry.

  • Orchestrate Cross-Functional Success: Build highly aligned, collaborative ecosystems where engineering, UX, sales, and marketing move in lockstep to hit ambitious financial and customer satisfaction goals.

  • Deliver Global Scale & Value: Continuous monitoring of customer landscapes to deploy intuitive, high-impact features that delight users worldwide and solve critical operational bottlenecks.

  • Demystify Complex Architectures: Transform intricate backend infrastructure processes into clean, scalable technical requirements, significantly accelerating engineering velocity and minimizing delivery risk.

Roles & Responsibilities (R&R)

1. Vision, Strategy & Strategy Adaptation

  • Own the long-term product vision and strategy, seamlessly integrating customer research, user experiences, and emerging technology trends into an actionable roadmap.

  • Maintain a highly flexible roadmap that can fluidly adapt to changing business priorities, market conditions, and technical discoveries without losing sight of overall goals.

  • Demonstrate bold thought leadership by thinking big, introducing disruptive product paradigms, and challenging legacy practices.

2. Requirements Definition & Lifecycle Management

  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, including comprehensive requirements definition, customer experience design, roadmap creation, and prioritization.

  • Translate highly complex IT operations and technical workflows into exceptionally clear, uncomplicated technical requirements for engineering squads.

  • Manage day-to-day delivery and operations, maintaining high execution standards in a fast-paced environment.

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Partner intimately with UX and Engineering teams to deeply understand and co-author the design and technology implications of proposed solutions.

  • Act as the primary communication bridge across the organization, keeping internal teams (Design, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Leadership) and external customer stakeholders completely aligned on timelines, launches, and value delivery.

  • Influence stakeholders at all levels of the business, building consensus around product direction through transparent, data-driven narratives.

4. Customer Advocacy & Co-Creation

  • Partner directly with global enterprise customers to prioritize problems, map out critical themes, and drive toward high-value outcomes.

  • Cultivate deep stakeholder empathy to translate customer friction points into intuitive, user-friendly features.

title: Manager - SOC
jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SOC Manager to lead and mature our 24x7 Security Operations Center (SOC). The role is responsible for overseeing security monitoring, incident response, threat detection, threat hunting, SOC automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. The SOC Manager will lead a team of security analysts and engineers while working closely with Product Security, Infrastructure, IT, and Engineering teams to strengthen the organization’s cyber resilience.

  • Lead and manage day-to-day Security Operations Center (SOC) activities, ensuring timely detection, investigation, containment, and remediation of security incidents.
  • Act as the Incident Commander for Critical and High severity cybersecurity incidents and coordinate cross-functional response efforts.
  • Drive continuous improvement of detection use cases, SIEM (XSIAM), SOAR automation, and SOC processes to improve operational efficiency.
  • Oversee security monitoring across cloud, endpoint, identity, network, and application environments.
  • Lead Threat Hunting activities and proactively identify emerging threats, attack techniques, and security gaps.
  • Manage security incidents throughout the entire incident lifecycle, including post-incident reviews and lessons learned.

  • Mentor and develop SOC analysts and engineers through coaching, technical guidance, and career development.
  • Prepare executive dashboards, operational reports, and security metrics for senior leadership.
  • Support audit, compliance, regulatory, and customer security requirements where applicable.

  • Lead workshops, webinars, and enablement programs that can be reused across customer segments and internal teams.
  • Standardize customer engagement methodologies and value realization practices.
  • Consolidate customer insights, adoption trends, feature requests, and operational challenges to influence product strategy and roadmap prioritization.
  • Participate in product reviews, beta programs, steering committees, and strategic customer initiatives.
  • Identify and implement AI-driven efficiencies that improve productivity, accelerate execution, and enhance team scalability.

Drive proactive customer engagement to improve adoption, reduce risk, and support retention.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and Account Managers on retention strategies through proactive engagement and adoption planning.
  • Identify adoption barriers, utilization gaps, operational inefficiencies, and customer risks using data-driven analysis.
  • Monitor customer health indicators, operational performance metrics, and adoption trends to proactively address risks.
  • Support at-risk account mitigation through Technical consultation, Workflow optimization, Solution recommendations and Executive alignment
  • Collaborate with the Risk Steering Committee by providing customer insights and contributing to mitigation strategies.

Contribute to organizational excellence while fostering collaboration and continuous learning.

Responsibilities

  • Support organizational initiatives that drive business impact and operational excellence.
  • Enable customer-facing teams through coaching, knowledge sharing, and technical enablement.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and customer obsession.
  • Collaborate effectively across Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to drive strategic programs and organizational priorities.
  • Continuously build AI expertise while contributing to team-wide AI initiatives and capability development.
